messages:
Ryan: FYI — HelioCare just pinged me. They want us to onboard an open model (stella-3b) and 'version-lock' to 1.2.0 across EU + APAC. Also asking for a private deployment option and quantized build. Can we triage?
Maya: Thanks Ryan. Quick clarifying q's: 1) expected QPS / peak traffic? 2) latency SLO (p95) and max seq length? 3) do they require private control plane or just VPC? 4) any contractual compliance needs?
Ryan: Answers from HelioCare: ~150 reqs/min avg, bursts to 1k/min; want p95 < 300ms for 256 tokens; prefer VPC with audit logs; contract requires SOC2 + data residency in EU/SG; model license is Apache-2.0 per vendor.
Lina: we ran their sample prompts against a local stella-3b quantized build — observed coherent outputs but some hallucination on clinical terms. They have a test-suite of ~120 prompts; want quality gating before rollout.
Alex: Initial eng notes: stella-3b 4-bit quant works but memory layout requires custom kernel on our runtime for efficient KV cache. Without kernel, p95 will be ~450ms on a g4dn-like node. We can do a short feasibility spike: build quant image + perf bench. Also need to verify tokenizer matches our tokenization pipeline.
Jordan: On infra — EU and APAC will need dedicated images and regional images for private deployments; we'll need KMS + customer-managed certs for their VPC. Capacity-wise, APAC currently has limited spare DGX slots for dedicated pools in 2 regions. Could do a soft-gating until we add more capacity.
Maya: Proposed acceptance criteria to add to backlog (draft):
- License check complete (legal sign-off on Apache-2.0)
- Pass model compatibility tests (tokenizer + weights)
- Perf: p95 < 300ms for 256 tokens in Dedicated config or documented fallback to hosted with <500ms (when private not available)
- Quality: pass HelioCare's 120 prompt regression set with no >5% drop vs baseline QA metrics
- Security: SOC2 + data-residency config verified + audit logs in place
- Docs: onboarding guide for private + default hosted routing, model manifest sample included
Ryan: That list looks good. From sales side, HelioCare will pay for initial dedicated pilot if we can guarantee EU residency. They want a timeline — can we give a rough ETA?
Alex: If we approve spike now, eng can deliver results in 10 business days: quant image + perf numbers and tokenization check. Full rollout (including infra & docs) is realistically 4–6 weeks after spike depending on infra capacity.
Lina: We should include a quality rollback plan in the acceptance criteria: automatic fallback to a vetted hosted variant if regression detected in prod. Also add monitoring hooks (per-prompt QA sampling).
Maya: Agreed. Action items: 1) I’ll create a product backlog ticket (P-?) with acceptance criteria above. 2) Alex to start spike (label: stella-3b-quant-spike). 3) Jordan to confirm EU/APAC capacity & provisional reservation. 4) Lina to run initial regression harness and share baseline results. 5) Legal to confirm license (Ryan to loop them in).
Ryan: Looping in legal now. HelioCare happy to share contract language.
IntegrationBot: ticket created: PROD-4271 "stella-3b onboarding — HelioCare" (assignee: Maya).
Maya: Tentative priority = P2 (customer pilot with paid pilot). If spike shows major perf gaps, we escalate to P1. Keep weekly sync; I'll update the backlog ticket with timelines and owners.
Alex: Noted — starting spike today, posting perf updates into the ticket thread.
Lina: Will schedule regression runs as soon as Alex uploads the quant artifact.
Jordan: I'll post infra capacity options in the ticket by EOD tomorrow.
Maya: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after spike — tag me in updates. :thumbsup:
